book.name: Aposel
book.title: Yesu nusi erungwa ongwa yal kobe, Aposel, ka main konagi erungwa

content: Yuda ka main yal singaba ka kol ere Pol tongwa

Ena are kaun anan kole muru wei sungure, Yuda ka main kenin erungwa yal bil kaan Ananayas, te goma yongwa yal taw kobe, te ka balungwa yal kaan Tetalas bole para wi ime ungwa. Urere yal bil Pilikis milungwa gul pire, Pol ka di mere si tongwa main di maribe erungwa.

Yalini, “Ere wo,” di gala dungure, Tetalas ka digwane waa Pol tere iru dungwa, “Na yal singaba bil Pilikiso, na yal kobe i kenin ere na te milinga, kura bilekire wai wen milebinwa. Main paangwa kwi i nomanin si pire i maribe eringire, na yal kobe gariba gul u wai pire milabinwa.
Kal iru eringa, gariba kole kole para wai pire gun ye i tomua.
Goma i kal wai eringa, ena malia ka baan araway dirabinga, i nigi de pire pirekenanwa. Ka baan tawle dirabinga piro.

Yal ta i taalime binanbile erungwa, te Yuda ibal gariba baan baan para muru milungwa yalin kobe kura gale tongwa, te Nasarete ai yal ka main duulin bile pirungwa ibal kobe, yalini ibalin kobe singaba milemua.
Yalini Yuda ka main ogu bil ala si kirime si terala di erungure, yalini kanin sibinwa. [Sibinga na Yuda ibal kile kaman ka main paangwa mere pire ka kol ere terabinba,
simil nen kenin erungwa yal, Ilisias, ure ka dagi dire na aa poraa sire awli omua.
Awli pire ka di mere si tobinga yal i milinga gul, ‘Ka kol erana po,’ di na tomua.] Yalini i sirin bile tenanga, na yal kobe ka di mere si tobinga main, i para iru piranwa.”
Yuda ibal para ka digwane waa tere, “Yalini ka dungwa kawen dimua,” dungwa.
Pol ka main di maribe ere Pilikis tongwa
Ena Pol ka dinama dire, yal bil si dugu dungure, Pol ka iru dungwa, “Gariba bilin iray i me erin binanbile ka kol piringire, na kanere ka kol main di maribe ere wai piriwa.
Na Yerusalem ai pire God ana dire deminin si tobinga, are kaun anan kole kole muru kawnan milin sutan tawle miliwa. Iru milebinga i ibal sirin bile tengire, dinangwa piranwa.
Na ka main ogu bil ala te ka main ogu ta ta ala, te ogu ai bil ala ibal bole ka bolebilin dibinga mo, ibal kobe den gule tobinga mo, na iru erebinga Yuda ibal ta kanekimua.
Ka kol ere na tongwa, ‘Kawen dimua,’ di maribe ere i ta di tekenangwa paamua.

Ka ta di maribe ere i terala piro. Yesu kol ta kwi bala di ibal tongwa yalin kobe, ‘Kakiibi kol dimua,’ dimba, main iray dungwa mere, na God ana dire deminin si teiwa. Mose kile kaman ka te ka kebe yal kobe bilungwa mere, para pire gi diwa.
‘Ibal wai te ibal digan para gulere alangwa, God iru eramua,’ dire yalin kobe pi tegi yongwa mere, na para pi tegi yeiwa.
Iru eriga God mabin mina te ibal kobe mabin mina gay ta gulekeralga, konagi nega wen dire eriwa.
“Yerusalem ai me erin taw milekire, kobile moni na ibalan kobe kal aa te nekungwa ibal terala dire, te God kabe ki terala dire, wiwa.
Na nomanin u wai nama dire, gaynan bigin sire pare Yuda ka main ogu bil ala miliga yalin kobe na kanemua. Ibal binanbile na bole milekungure, wi yau ta dikimua.
Iru miliiba, Yuda ibal Esia gariba gul ki paangwa u milemua. Yalin kobe na kanan na tenangwa, inin i milinga gul ure ka digwane waa na tenamba.
Mo, u ku bilungwa mina miliga, ‘Na kal ki eremua,’ yalin kobe abila milungwa di maribe eramo?
Ka taran ta tawle dinamua. U ku bilungwa gul suna ale miliga, na iru gala diga, ‘Gulere alamua, na ka iru pire diga pire, ka kol ere na tomua.’”

Dungure Yesu kol kwi bala di ibal tongwa Pilikis main wen pirere, “Kemina ka para dimua,” dire iru di yal kobe tongwa, “Simil nen kenin erungwa yal kaan Ilisias u bawa dinangwa, ka kol di bawa dirabinwa.”
Dire pare iru di simil nen singaba ta kaman tongwa, “Pol kanin pai milangwa i kenin ere milanba, yalini taw imore milamua. Yalini ibayal ye nongwa aa te wai ere terala di unangure, manaa di tekio.”
Pilikis Pol kanin pai tongure me erin sutan milungwa
Ena are kaun taw wei sungure, Pilikis te ebinbi Dirusila, Yuda abal milungwa, urere “Pol awli wo,” dungure urere, pire gi di Yesu Kirisito tongwa main di yal sui tongure, pirungwa.

Kabin sire wai wen milangwa ka, te aan bule ere milangwa ka, te God ka kol pire ibal tenangwa, ka para di tongure Pilikis buul kune kuril pire dungwa, “Para wa, ere po. Kaun ta dinangwa, ‘Ere wo,’ di teralwa.”
Pol kobile moni yalini tenama di pire morin morin, “Ere wo,” di Pol tongure, u milemia ka diria ere milungwa.
Me erin sutan wei sungure pare, yal ta kaan Posias Pesitas pi yal bil Pilikis konagi erungwa ain ongwa. Yuda ibal wai pire Pilikis tenama dire, “Pol kanin paingwa imo mile painamua,” dungwa.
